رَاضِبٌ Vehement, or abundant and extensive, rain: (S, K:) or rain pouring incessantly, in large drops. (AA, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also A species of the [lote-tree called] سِدْر: (S, K:) one of which is called رَاضِبَةٌ, [with respect to which it is a coll. gen. n.,] and ↓ رَضَبَةٌ , (K,) with respect to which latter, if this be correct, it is a quasi-pl. n. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
